question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Thankful
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Thankful"** means feeling or expressing gratitude; appreciative. (आभारी)

 
 
• **Example: **She was thankful for the opportunity to work with such talented colleagues.
 
 
 
• **"Obliged" **means grateful or indebted because of a favor or service. (आभारी)
 
 
• **Example: **I am much obliged to you for your help in this matter.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Thankful' **is **'Obliged'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ungrateful **(अकृतज्ञ): Not feeling or showing gratitude.

 
 
• **Example:** He was ungrateful despite all the help he received.
 
 
 
• **Affirmation **(पुष्टि): The action or process of affirming something or being affirmed.
 
 
• **Example: **She nodded in affirmation, agreeing to the proposal.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not discovered or known about; uncertain.
 
 
• **Example:** The origins of the ritual are obscure and unknown.
 
 

3c:Tbbc,

The correct answer is: Option 2
